name: Area 10 mounting instruction
placementTarget: Instruction for sticker-05_area-10. Not itself placed on the board.
text: Put this sticker on the game board onto Area 10 as a reminder to add 15 more Supply cubes to the stockpile during setup each month.

mechanics.effect: Place the +15 marker on Area 10 of the game board. Each month's setup adds 15 more Supply cubes to the stockpile.
